title: 1967 Savoy College Reunion News
text:
Former Savoy College Students' Names Are Listed In This Issue

We have been requested to again publish the names of the ex-students of Savoy Male and Female College from 1876 to 1890, and we are asking anyone who can add any names to the list or make any corrections to write to Mrs. Barbara Lips, 305 Geneseo Rd., San Antonio, Texas 78209.

Mrs. Lips, granddaughter of Prof. R. R. Halsell, is wanting a correct list of names for a memorial to be placed on the present Savoy school grounds where she plans a memorial garden.
